(2) The visual transitions into rapid gameplay footage where a female game character moves through a jungle, engaging in combat with colorful purple and yellow magical effects. She then brings her hands together to clap rhythmically. The background behind her remains a plain, light-colored wall. Digital overlays of social media icons and her username appear at the bottom of the frame.
